verdict.rationale: Lium's evidence is about making the platform usable by the user's own external agents: an agent-friendly API and CLI, a docs and pricing MCP server, a SKILL file, and budget-scoped keys. None of it describes an AI assistant built into the product that tasks can be delegated to. Those agent-facing surfaces are developer building blocks for outside agents, not an in-product assistant, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
